verdict.rationale: First-party docs say CodeRabbit appends a plain-language summary, grouped by change type, to the PR description after a review. Every review also posts a structured walkthrough comment at the top of the PR thread. Auto-review runs within moments of a PR opening, and range-specific summaries and diagrams help with large diffs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the summaries and walkthroughs themselves help reviewers orient.
